verdict: Strong 28-day ROAS, but purchases have stalled the last three days.
narrative: Your Meta ads returned £4.16 for every £1 spent over the last 28 days, with the Muslim Subscription Box campaign carrying the bulk of that result. However, the headline masks a hard stop: zero purchases were recorded on August 13–15, with $151.75 in spend running against no revenue — that stall is being treated as a real signal, not a blip. At the same time, Instagram reach has slid roughly 44% over the past four weeks, consistent with the current creative running its course, and Google Business Profile actions dropped sharply at the end of the week. New ad creative is being prioritised this week to break the purchase drought, and the subscription page checkout path is under review to ensure sessions are converting properly.
